$comment: Inventory station: concrete SKUs/items and quantities derived from deposited requests.
title: ShoppingItemsResult

items.$comment: Normalized line items for this twice-weekly cycle. Cap keeps audit fan-out bounded.
One buyable line. id must stay stable through Audit, Procurement, and Purchasing.

id.$comment: Stable line id; office-shopping prompt uses {requestId}-item-N (e.g. req-001-item-1).

name.$comment: Specific product description (not a vague category).

quantity.$comment: How many units to buy this cycle.

unit.$comment: Unit of measure: each, box, ream, pack, case, etc.

category.$comment: Optional bucket: paper, kitchen, IT, cleaning, other.

request_ids.$comment: Intake request ids that drove this line (merge duplicates here).

evidence.$comment: Citations back to deposited requests or policy docs.
